children: Copper rises in Asian trade. Booming investment in data centers has been driving expectations of strong demand in the base metal, supporting prices in recent months, ANZ Research analysts say in a note. Signs of robust demand have also partly offset concerns around economic growth stemming from rising energy prices, they add. Ongoing supply tightness could also buoy copper. The three-month copper futures contract on the London Metal Exchange gains 0.45% to $14,218.00 a metric ton. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
